sources.label: Federal Register API
sources.note: Rules, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents published on or after 2026-10-17. Executive orders published on or after 2026-05-11 are also merged into ledger/eos.json by EO number.

sources.label: Congress.gov API
sources.note: CONGRESS_API_KEY is not set. Bills come from GovInfo and House votes come from the Clerk. Senate roll calls are not fetched without this key.

sources.label: GovInfo congressional bills
sources.note: Newest bill versions posted to GovInfo. The date is when GovInfo published that version, not the date of introduction.

sources.label: GovInfo public and private laws
sources.note: Newest slip laws on the GovInfo public-and-private-law RSS. Enactment dates come from the existing ledger or from GovInfo MODS dateIssued. RSS publication time is not used as the enactment date.

sources.label: Supreme Court slip opinions
sources.note: Official slip-opinion tables for October Terms 2026 and 2025. The summary text is the Court's own listing, stored only when the page provides it.

sources.label: CourtListener
sources.note: COURTLISTENER_TOKEN is not set. Supreme Court slip opinions still sync from supremecourt.gov. Set the token to add federal appellate opinions.

sources.label: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.note: Latest House roll calls from the Clerk's roll-call XML. Totals are the Clerk's yea/nay totals. Checked calendar year 2026; latest roll call was 314.
